name: vscode-prompt-optimizer
description: Fully local prompt optimization, semantic cache, and token cost forecasting for VS Code. Your prompts and code never leave your machine — no telemetry, no cloud processing. Works with GitHub Copilot.

badges.description: Fully local — no data leaves your machine

chatParticipants.name: promptoptimizer

disambiguation.description: The user wants to compress a coding prompt, inspect local prompt context, or estimate token cost before asking Copilot.
examples: Optimize this prompt before I send it to Copilot
Estimate the token cost for this coding request
Show me what cached or buffered context Prompt Optimizer can use

promptProxy.targetModel.description: The compiler target model compiler style to optimize the prompt formatting layout for.

promptProxy.dbPath.description: Custom path for the local SQLite semantic cache database. If left blank, it defaults to the global storage path.

promptProxy.processingMode.description: Query processing mode for the cache lookup: 'blocking' stands for precise sequential execution; 'non-blocking' uses an async background lookup.

promptProxy.enableSessionContext.description: Feed recent user prompts and analysis results back as conversation-aware session history to the optimizer engine.

promptProxy.pricingInput.description: Input cost per 1K tokens in USD (defaults to $0.0015).

promptProxy.pricingOutput.description: Output cost per 1K tokens in USD (defaults to $0.002).

promptProxy.enableSecretDetection.description: Scan prompts for potential secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) before sending and show a warning in the panel.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the warning (e.g. 'My internal token').

matchMode.description: How to evaluate the custom pattern against the full prompt text. 'regex' uses JavaScript regex, 'like' uses SQL LIKE semantics, and the other modes do case-insensitive string matching.

pattern.description: The raw match input. For 'regex', provide a JavaScript regex source without delimiters. For 'like', use SQL LIKE syntax. For string modes, provide the literal text to match.

promptProxy.secretPatterns.description: Additional custom secret-detection rules. Each entry must include a 'pattern', can optionally set 'matchMode' (regex | like | contains | startsWith | endsWith | exact), and can include a 'label'.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Prompt Optimizer
walkthroughs.description: Optimize prompts locally before sending to Copilot.

steps.title: Open the Prompt Optimizer panel
steps.description:
Click the Prompt Optimizer view in the Activity Bar (or press `Ctrl+Alt+P`).
[Open panel](command:prompt-proxy.focusPanel)

steps.title: Optimize your first prompt
steps.description:
Paste a prompt and press `Ctrl+Enter`, or hit the **Optimize** button in the status bar to optimize whatever is in your editor selection.
[Optimize now](command:prompt-proxy.optimizeChatPrompt)

steps.title: Pick a default mode
steps.description:
Agent answers directly, Optimize shows analysis, Direct pre-fills chat.
[Select mode](command:prompt-proxy.selectMode)

steps.title: Curate workspace memory
steps.description:
Drop notes into `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `.promptoptimizer/memory.md` — Prompt Optimizer will index them locally for richer prompts.
[Open memory file](command:prompt-proxy.openMemoryFile)
